cases.revisedExample: One morning I woke up and discovered that I could speak to birds. I felt excited, but a sparrow asked me to rescue its friend from a locked shed. I followed it through the garden and found a frightened robin inside. Although I was nervous, I asked my neighbour for the key and gently opened the door. The robin flew out safely and sang a beautiful song. That evening, I felt proud because my unusual ability had helped someone. I hoped I could use it again tomorrow.

cases.revisedExample: I woke up and discovered I could fly. At first I was amazed and felt a rush of excitement. I flew over my neighborhood, watching the streetlights blink below. I tried to land on my balcony, but the wind was too strong, and I crashed into a potted plant. My mother called me down, and I felt embarrassed. Later, I used my new ability to help a neighbor pick up fallen apples from the garden. By sunset, I was tired but thrilled by my new power.

cases.revisedExample: My favourite sport is football. One morning I woke up and discovered I could hear the thoughts of the ball. At first I felt nervous, but the idea of predicting its bounce thrilled me. I practiced with my friends after school, and the ball guided me to perfect passes. On Saturday, during a match, the ball whispered the exact angle to beat the goalkeeper. My teammates were amazed, and I felt like a superhero on the field. The new power made every game exciting, but I also learned to respect the ball’s quiet voice.

Jack and Jane climbed out of the boat and walked along the sunny beach. They wanted to explore the beautiful island, so they followed a narrow path into the trees. Suddenly, they heard a strange noise above their heads. Jane felt frightened, but Jack pointed at several playful monkeys on the branches. The animals jumped from tree to tree while the children watched in surprise. After taking some photographs, they returned safely to their boat. They were tired but excited, and they agreed that their adventure had been wonderful.

It was a warm and sunny Saturday afternoon. Anna decided to ride her bicycle to the lake for a picnic. On the way, she stopped at a small shop and bought some sandwiches and a drink. The friendly shopkeeper wished her a lovely day. When she reached the water, she sat on the grass and watched ducks swimming nearby. She felt peaceful as she ate her lunch and enjoyed the sunshine. Later, she packed everything carefully and cycled home, happy that she had spent such a pleasant afternoon outside.

One morning I found a mysterious door behind the school library. I opened it and stepped into a bright forest filled with enormous flowers. At first I felt frightened because I could not see the way back. Then a small fox appeared and offered to guide me. We crossed a narrow bridge and found the door hidden behind a tree. I thanked the fox and hurried through it before the bell rang. Back at school, I felt relieved but excited. I wondered whether my strange new friend would remember me.
